test_framework: No test framework configured - validation via build
verification_instructions: Run `npm run build` to confirm no compilation errors. The project has no unit test framework so build success is the primary verification.
environment_constraints: Open internet available. Node.js and npm pre-installed.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing patterns: page component in src/pages/, components in src/components/<module>/, seed data in src/data/, storage helpers in src/lib/storage.js, context state in src/context/AppContext.jsx, route in App.jsx, nav item in Sidebar.jsx.
key_patterns: Each module follows: (1) seed data file in src/data/ using seededRandom pattern, (2) getter/setter functions in src/lib/storage.js, (3) state + update functions in AppContext.jsx, (4) page component with tab navigation using TABS array pattern, (5) individual tab components in src/components/<module>/, (6) route in App.jsx, (7) nav link in Sidebar.jsx with Lucide icon. Tab UI uses gray-100 bg with active white bg and [#5B2D8E] text color. localStorage with 'propela_ops_' prefix.
directory_structure: src/pages/ - page-level components | src/components/ - feature directories | src/context/ - AppContext global state | src/data/ - seed data generators | src/lib/ - utility functions including storage.js | src/hooks/ - custom hooks
